versions.content: The EcuM EcuM_AL_DriverInitZero and EcuM_AL_- DriverInitOne functions shall be called by the EcuM_Init function on each core. The implementation of these callout functions shall ensure that only those MCAL mod- ules are initialized that run on the currently active core.
